gap_reduction.note: All fillable gaps eliminated. Remaining 19 are genuine data unavailability.

provider_not_found.root_cause: cninfo API returned no results for these ts_code+year+type queries; some may be restructured or legacy issuers
provider_not_found.remediation: Manual cninfo search; check if company reorganized or delisted

officially_not_disclosed.root_cause: CSRC/Exchange disclosure registry confirms 2024 annual not filed as of 2026-07-22
officially_not_disclosed.remediation: Monitor filing deadline; re-query after regulatory extension expires

summary_only.root_cause: Provider returned 年报摘要 (annual summary) not full 年度报告; full text not available via cninfo for these issuers
summary_only.remediation: Check SSE/SZSE direct filing portal for full text version

wrong_report_type_only.root_cause: Provider returned semi-annual or quarterly report when annual was requested; annual not separately filed
wrong_report_type_only.remediation: Check if issuer uses integrated reporting format

manual_review_required.root_cause: Entity ambiguity, ts_code mismatch, or company reorganization prevents automated resolution
manual_review_required.remediation: Human analyst verification required before ingestion
